task.population: The phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement domain of nonpregnant women aged 20–44 in NHANES August 2021–August 2023; RIDEXPRG=2, both measured hemoglobin and raw ferritin, positive phlebotomy weight. Pregnancy unknown/incomplete excluded; no CRP restriction. Equal-weight virtual rows represent this domain only under explicit transport assumptions. No individual measurements or target outcome summaries are supplied.

excluded_cohorts: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

transport.choice: Transport both source threshold prevalences and the ferritin geometric mean unchanged to the target domain as explicit scenario assumptions.
transport.interpretation: Equal-weight independent virtual people from an assumed target population law, not reconstructed source participants or target survey records.

hemoglobin.parent_location_rule: Solve P(Hb < 12) = 258/1671 under the truncated-normal distribution.

ferritin.measurement_scale: raw ferritin in ug/L; no inflammation adjustment

dependence.interpretation: Assumed latent correlation; neither a reported raw Pearson correlation nor a reported rank, adjusted, residual, or multilevel correlation.
